column4: SELECT name, (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products) AS max_price FROM categories;

column2: Paano gumamit ng subquery sa WHERE?
column4: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE active = 1);
SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE active = 1) AS active_users;

column2: Paano i-compare ang column sa subquery result?
column4: SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);
SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);
